critical_code_review_comments: routes/marketplace_giftcards.py:75-80 — the product doc stores `sponsor_name` snapshotted from marketplace_profiles.public_name at create time. If the merchant later renames their business, `sponsor_name` on existing gift-card PRODUCTS is stale until they PATCH (the PATCH branch at lines 92-94 does refresh sponsor_name). But issued gift_cards (routes/gift_cards.py:74) also snapshot sponsor_name at MINT time and stay stale forever. Consider deriving sponsor_name on read from the current marketplace_profiles record.

routes/marketplace_giftcards.py:52 — `_validate_denoms` silently DROPS out-of-range denoms and only raises 400 if the resulting list is empty. E.g. request [100, 2_000_000] returns 200 with [100] persisted — the client thinks 2M was accepted. Should either reject the entire request when any denom is out of range OR echo back the cleaned list so the client can reconcile.

routes/marketplace_giftcards.py:76 — `category` falls back to 'shop' which may not match the merchant's actual profile category (e.g. cafe/restaurant/wellness). Consider requiring category or defaulting to p.get('category') and only falling back to 'shop' if truly missing.

routes/marketplace_orders.py:43-62 (& marketplace_products.py:296) — `_pick_gift_card` iterates ALL of a user's active gift cards to pick best. For high-volume users this is O(N) per checkout. Add a Mongo compound index on gift_cards({owner_user_id:1, status:1, business_id:1, balance_cents:-1}).

routes/marketplace_giftcards.py:112-130 — consumer listing does NOT filter by market/geo. A user in Los Angeles browsing a Dubai venue's /giftcards page can buy a card that will only redeem in Dubai. Document this on the UI (venue-scoped redemption note) — the ShopGiftCardsRadioLife.jsx success text mentions 'auto-applies at checkout' but doesn't clarify VENUE-scoped.

frontend/ShopGiftCardsRadioLife.jsx:47 & mobile/[id].tsx — alert() on purchase failure is a poor UX for insufficient_points. Show inline error near gc-buy button (mobile already suppresses in some paths; verify both surfaces surface the error clearly).

MerchantGiftCardsRadioLife.jsx:23 & 33 — silent try/catch swallows load & save errors (alerts on parse failure only). A backend 400 bad_denominations after client validation fails silently — surface the error to the merchant.
